title: Potion Witch and Green Slime
description: An elderly witch with white hair in a bun and a green-blue patchwork cloak stands behind a stone counter, smiling with closed eyes while holding a glowing green slime creature with a cracked smiley face in one hand and a red rose in the other. Shelves filled with colorful potion bottles and hanging dried herbs are visible in the background of the magical shop interior.
prompt: An elderly witch with white hair in a bun wearing a green and blue patchwork cloak stands behind a stone counter, gently holding a large glowing green slime ball with a happy cracked smiley face and dripping edges. She holds a red rose in her other hand and smiles with eyes closed. Behind her are purple shelves filled with colorful potion bottles and hanging dried herbs in a magical shop with stone walls.
